description: Return the prices and the complete published pricing terms for QConsul's two bookable services: Standard Hourly at $425/hour and the Executive 1:1 Subscription at $399/month. Read-only and idempotent; the terms are returned verbatim from qconsultai.com, structured to mirror the Services page. Usage: call this when a customer asks what a session costs or what the cancellation, reschedule, and refund rules are, before booking. Returns prices and terms only; it books nothing and shows no availability. For the service catalog and ids, use list_services; for open times, use check_availability.
name: get_pricing_and_terms
title: Get pricing and terms
